Lenny (00:00:05): Ravi, how do you know a product has product-market fit?

Ravi Retention (00:00:30): Retention curves flatten. If your cohort retention curve goes flat instead of decaying to zero, people keep coming back and you have product-market fit. Retention is the foundation of every growth strategy.

Lenny (00:03:10): What if the curve keeps falling?

Ravi Retention (00:03:30): Then fix the product before spending on acquisition. More signups will not rescue poor retention.
